I'm a landlord managing a property at 14 Birchwood Lane in Natick, MA. The current tenant's lease is coming up for renewal and they're currently paying $1,950/month. I've already pulled together raw data on five comparable rental listings in the area into a file in the workspace — it has all the details on each listing including rent, features, and condition.

Can you produce a full rental market analysis report for this property so I can decide what rent to charge at renewal? The report should be saved as a file named comps-14-birchwood-lane-natick-[today's date].md. Make sure to include side-by-side comparisons of the comps with any feature adjustments, a clear recommendation on what rent to set, and any relevant notes about Massachusetts landlord-tenant law that apply to this situation.
